meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.7
§ Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"
a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat

elsewhere.note: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
